evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was 5.5 ppm at growth onset.
O2 increased to 21.2 ppm during growth.
O2 has risen persistently to 39.1 ppm despite stable argon flow, indicating an atmosphere anomaly.
Temperature is 749.9 °C versus 750 °C setpoint; argon is 99.8 sccm versus 100 sccm setpoint.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; null pressure readings cannot verify the required growth-stage pressure.

args.missing_evidence: A valid tube-pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; independent O2 verification and leak/exhaust-path checks are needed to identify the cause of rising oxygen. No sample characterization is available.
